limitations: Client sessions use offline-auth loopback fixtures, not Microsoft authentication or public networking.
Client device and VM evidence can be forged; no hardware attestation guarantee.
The 37 exact ID entries are an evidenced catalog, not all market cheats.
Forge 1.8.9 graphical tests disable the Forge splash screen on this machine; no native Forge 1.8.8 mod.
Bukkit protocol fixtures have explicitly documented temporary QA policy changes; rendered clients use the complete strict default policy.
Old Paper Grim and Fabric 1.16.5 AntiXray compatibility tests use their reported historical Verdict hashes, not these new JARs.
Grim and AntiXray third-party binaries are separate and not included in these thirteen JARs.
Remote CI rebuilds are distinct from the exact local tested binaries; remote results and publication downloads are recorded separately.
